title: CNET Finds 75% of US Adults Couldn't Care Less About a Foldable iPhone - CNET
summary: Analysts say the phone could be dubbed the iPhone Ultra (previously nicknamed the iPhone Fold and iPhone Flip). On average, US adults are willing to spend $781 on a new foldable iPhone.
